name: hud_ui_counter_apply_from_layout_node
description: HudUiCounter::ApplyFromLayoutNode loads counter state images, stores layout coordinates, updates position/clip, installs the default image, and registers the counter with the HUD manager.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; this helper is deferred to a coherent HUD counter/source-cluster tier S pass.
The native smoke uses a temporary texture pack to exercise the real zImage::TexDir_FindOrCreateByPath provider path with test images.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x40f070 validates rejecting non-array nodes, loading three state images from payload[1..3] through zImage::TexDirFindOrCreateByPath, copying payload[4]/payload[5] into layout X/Y fields, calling HudUiCounter::UpdateLayoutPosition, installing stateImages[0] through HudUiWidget::SetImageBorrowedAndInvalidate, adding the counter to g_HudUiMgr, and returning 1.

The native smoke verifies real texture-pack image loads, layout coordinate stores, delegated position and clip updates, default borrowed image installation, invalidation, HudUiMgr child/parent links, and the non-array rejection path.
